entries.title: Psalms 40:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.>> I waited patiently for the LORD; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry. {I waited...: Heb. In waiting I waited}

words.text: . {I waited...: Heb. In waiting I waited}

entries.title: Psalms 40:2
segments: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, [and] established my goings. {an...: Heb. a pit of noise}

entries.title: Psalms 40:3
segments: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, [even] praise unto our God: many shall see [it], and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 40:4
segments: Blessed [is] that man that maketh the LORD his trust, and respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.

entries.title: Psalms 40:5
segments: Many, O LORD my God, [are] thy wonderful works [which] thou hast done, and thy thoughts [which are] to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order unto thee: [if] I would declare and speak [of them], they are more than can be numbered. {they cannot...: or, none can order them unto thee}

words.text: [which are] to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order
. {they cannot...: or, none can order them unto thee}

entries.title: Psalms 40:6
segments: ¶Sacrifice and offering thou didst not desire; mine ears hast thou opened: burnt offering and sin offering hast thou not required. {opened: Heb. digged}

entries.title: Psalms 40:7
segments: Then said I, Lo, I come: in the volume of the book [it is] written of me,

entries.title: Psalms 40:8
segments: I delight to do thy will, O my God: yea, thy law [is] within my heart. {within...: Heb. in the midst of my bowels}

words.text: . {within...: Heb. in the midst of my bowels}

entries.title: Psalms 40:9
segments: I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: lo, I have not refrained my lips, O LORD, thou knowest.

entries.title: Psalms 40:10
segments: I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation: I have not concealed thy lovingkindness and thy truth from the great congregation.

entries.title: Psalms 40:11
segments: ¶Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O LORD: let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me.

entries.title: Psalms 40:12
segments: For innumerable evils have compassed me about: mine iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of mine head: therefore my heart faileth me. {falleth: Heb. forsaketh}

words.text: upon me, so that I am not able

entries.title: Psalms 40:13
segments: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me: O LORD, make haste to help me.

entries.title: Psalms 40:14
segments: Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil.

entries.title: Psalms 40:15
segments: Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame that say unto me, Aha, aha.

entries.title: Psalms 40:16
segments: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: let such as love thy salvation say continually, The LORD be magnified.

words.text: in thee: let such as love

entries.title: Psalms 40:17
segments: But I [am] poor and needy; [yet] the Lord thinketh upon me: thou [art] my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.
